items.a: Yes. Evidence logging + namespace isolation meet all major compliance frameworks. We're currently pursuing SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA certifications.

items.q: Can we bring our own LLM models?
items.a: Yes. A11 supports Gemini, Grok, GPT-4, Claude, and custom fine-tuned models. Configure your preferred routing in settings.
.epack bundles include: all evidence logs (signed), reasoning chains, retrieved chunks, confidence scores, and governance events. Verification keys are included.
